notes.title: Patch Demo
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484896/7da21f2949f34fa552468151e57e5dd910904f26.png"][/img][/p][p]This week we've fixed a series of bugs in the Lifelong demo. [/p][p][/p][h3]These include:[/h3][list][*][p][b]The mascot dance.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Creation of a tutorial for basic movements, jumping, crouching and running.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added interaction feedback for the salaryman.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Less confusing text for certain characters on the objectives to be achieved.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Less visually aggressive surveillance camera shader.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you still have bugs, don't hesitate to let us know on the Lifelong discord or directly on Steam.[/p][p]
In the meantime, we're continuing to develop the game and you can follow the project's progress on the networks.[/p]
